name: conqueror_last_stand
author: HexHaki, reworked for HexPiece 2.1.1
description: Last Stand: the legs give out and the user sinks to both knees, raises their hands and stares down at them, lets them fall, then tilts their head back to stare at the sky as the will builds -- held on a tremble that grows right up to the detonation.
